criteria.statement: Misconfigured reconciliation (1100 immediate attempts) cannot exceed lane or aggregate bursts; rejection happens before relay I/O.
Every gateway (RelayPool, SoulFactory bus, Signet management, NIP-46 bunker) shares one process-wide controller; nil injection never disables admission.
Per-relay wire budgets bound actual frames, including NIP-42 AUTH retries, across concurrent publishers.
A relay rate limit opens the breaker for every gateway; late successes cannot clear a newer circuit; mixed fan-out records acceptance and circuit state.
Reconnect replay suppresses only destinations that accepted the exact event; failed or new destinations remain eligible; concurrent duplicates are refused.
A 1100-event operation is paced by bulk capacity, never flushed and never failed for size; priority capacity remains reserved.
Operation queues are FIFO, bounded, cancellable, and time-limited; declared sizes and lifetimes are enforced.
The kill switch hot-reloads, fails closed when unreadable, and stops operations, outbox redelivery, and ContextVM retries.
Outbox redelivery expires events one hour after durable enqueue, never resends an expired event, and stops a batch on admission refusal while preserving the cause.
The static guard catches aliased, method-value, method-expression, connect-then-publish, pool, Cascadia, and raw NIP-46 bypasses and rejects stale allowlist entries.
Repository-native container build, full tests, vet, race checks, and exact image provenance pass.
A staged canary shows bounded event rate, zero steady-state relay rejection, real operator-result and tombstone delivery, and a proven rollback, with no relay-limit, key, ACL, or custody change.
